name: Google Cloud
description: Google Cloud from any session, in place of the gcloud CLI: any Google Cloud REST API as you, plus tools for projects, logs, Cloud Run, billing, APIs and Cloud DNS. Reads run at once; every change waits for your confirm.

connections.why: Reads and, after you confirm each one on a card, changes your Google Cloud resources (DNS records, APIs, anything the REST APIs offer). Google offers no narrower scope that covers them.
